sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(p.product_id, 10) AS product_id,
  AVG(p.product_length_cm) AS product_length_cm,
  AVG(p.product_height_cm) AS product_height_cm,
  AVG(p.product_width_cm) AS product_width_cm,
  AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS product_weight_g,
  COUNT(oi.order_id) AS item_count,
  AVG( (p.product_length_cm * p.product_height_cm * p.product_width_cm) / 6000.0 ) AS dimensional_weight_kg,
  AVG( p.product_weight_g / 1000.0 ) AS actual_weight_kg,
  AVG( ABS(oi.freight_value) ) AS avg_freight_value,
  SUM( CASE WHEN ABS(oi.freight_value) > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )::FLOAT / COUNT(oi.order_id) AS pct_high_cost,
  CASE WHEN AVG( ABS(oi.freight_value) ) > 50 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS high_cost
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_length_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL
  AND oi.freight_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_id;
